content.en: UNIDO focuses on **Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID)**. Its primary objective is to assist developing countries and economies in transition in their industrialization efforts. It operates through three thematic priorities: creating shared prosperity, advancing economic competitiveness, and safeguarding the environment.

content.en: Do not confuse UNIDO with the World Trade Organization (WTO); UNIDO focuses on industrial development, not trade regulation.
